label: 1. Saying you can't is not an option.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Saying you can't is not an option.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You have to do it.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: It sounds nice, but...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: it just feels like a lot.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Why's that?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you feeling overwhelmed?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Yeah, kind of.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: If you're overwhelmed by the idea of attention, why did you become a pop star?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: That's not what I meant.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: You're worried because Anis isn't here.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Are you reading this?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You have to perform.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: This is no longer just a T.T. STAR farewell concert.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Err...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I kinda heard about that, but

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: how did this happen?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Manager.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Mind explaining?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Typing it all out is a chore for someone my age.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Anis taking down the black spire was broadcast live across the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Everyone was in an uproar over it, asking who she was.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Information started popping up everywhere.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Not just about Anis, but about T.T. STAR too.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: And that led to a pouring in of eyewitness accounts of Anis during the crystal terrorist attack.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Oh.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Luckily, though,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: nothing about Smile Time surfaced.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I mean, even if it had, it would've been deleted anyway.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: A former pop star who stepped away from the limelight

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: ends up saving the Ark...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: How could anyone resist such a juicy story?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You're the talk of the town now.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Not just among music fans, but among everyone in the Ark.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: In a good way, of course.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So, Mustang decided to dial things up a notch.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: The farewell concert is no longer just that.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: The focus is now on putting the public's mind at rest.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: We've even got the Central Government backing us.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: As such, your involvement is no longer optional.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: But I'm up on the surface right now.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: We pushed the date back as far as we could.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: The music and choreography are both coming together nicely.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You can finish up what you're doing and then join us for practice.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I have no idea when things will wrap up here though.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If you even think about backing out...

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: I'll run up to the surface myself and smack you.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I'm just saying that realistically I don't see how it'll work.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: We'll work on getting the choreography and the music down.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: You finish up your work and join us as soon as you can.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Like I said, I don't know when we'll be done.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: You're good at what you do, right?

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: So take care of your business and hurry back.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: We'll get everything ready.
